rune.lootrunes.ascendance.description: Long kill streaks add increasingly many extra rolls.
rune.lootrunes.echoes.description: Repeats one drop remembered from your previous kill.
rune.lootrunes.improvisation.description: Changing finishing weapon between kills adds another loot roll.
rune.lootrunes.migration.description: Changing biome between kills adds another loot roll.
rune.lootrunes.plenty.description: Adds one extra roll from the mob's own loot table.
rune.lootrunes.sacrifice.description: Trades the normal drops for two fresh rolls.
